messages:
ryan: flagging CI alert from secret-sleuth: a plaintext .env was pushed to partner-repo (mirror). it contains VAULT_TOKEN and a legacy gcp service key. severity: high.

sofia: confirmed. alert shows exposure window ~01:07-01:12 UTC. file path: integrations/partner/config/.env.prod

anika: who had write access to that mirror? looks like deprec-jenkins svcacc made the push.

ops-bot: Push detected by repo-monitor: user=svc-deprec-jenkins@redwood-ci, repo=partner-repo, commit=7b2f4a2. Automated quarantine applied (branch: remove-privs).

ryan: immediate containment: revoke the exposed credentials and remove file from history (git filter-branch or bfg). who can revoke the gcp key quickly?

tom: i can revoke the GCP service key. key id: projects/redwood/keys/partner-ingest-key/versions/3. doing now.

keymaster-bot: GCP key version 3 disabled by tom at 01:20 UTC.

sofia: good. next: the VAULT_TOKEN — we need to rotate the token and any tokens minted with it. list the mounts and roles used by that token first.

vault-bot: query: token lookup for token id pattern from .env -> token belongs to role=deploy-batch, namespace=integrations, policies=[read-secrets,deploy]. TTL remaining: 12h.

anika: kill that token and any child tokens immediately. sofia, ryan — can you coordinate rotation for deploy-batch consumers?

sofia: killing now:
```
vault token revoke -namespace=integrations -token=REDACTED_OLD
vault token revoke -namespace=integrations -accessors $(vault token lookup -namespace=integrations -format=json | jq -r '.data.accessor')
```

vault-bot: revoke requests accepted. token marked revoked at 01:25 UTC.

ryan: create new role-token with least privilege and short TTL, then push to our CI secret store. also rotate any k8s secrets that mount deploy-batch creds.

sofia: creating new token with TTL=2h and renewable=false. updating CI secret:
```
# in secrets manager
redwood-ci/integrations/deploy-batch -> VAULT_TOKEN=REDACTED_NEW
```

ops-bot: CI secret updated and pipeline re-run disabled for partner-repo to prevent further pushes.

anika: we should also scrub the git history in partner-repo and ask the partner to rotate any inbound creds they might have used. i'll open a partner communication.

ryan: for chain-of-custody, we need to capture the leaked blob and store it in a sealed bucket (kms-wrapped) before removal. put a copy into gs://secops-evidence/INC-2026-051 with retention.

sofia: uploading and wrapping with kms key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/secops/cryptoKeys/evidence-key. will log SHA256.

secret-sleuth-bot: evidence blob stored: gs://secops-evidence/INC-2026-051/env-7b2f4a2.enc, sha256=3b7a2f... . Access limited to secops group.

anika: follow-up checklist:
- revoke GCP key (tom) [done]
- revoke vault token (sofia) [done]
- rotate CI/store token and update consumers (ryan) [in progress]
- scrub git history + contact partner (anika) [in progress]
- run scan for similar files across mirrors (ops-bot)
- postmortem and ticket INC-2026-051 (assigned to anika)

ryan: one more: did the RBAC sweep earlier this week remove any auditing bindings? i want a full audit trail before we purge the repo entry.

keymaster-bot: audit-logs for projects/redwood are intact for 01:00-02:00 UTC. no sink gaps detected.

sofia: excellent. also reminder: any tokens issued from the old token need to be rotated — list of mounts that used deploy-batch role: secret/data/integrations/*, kv-v2/integrations/partner. I'll run a job to rotate those keys.

ops-bot: scheduled rotation job created: rotate-integrations-secrets-3060001300 -> runs in 15m.

anika: notifying partner lead with redacted evidence and recommended rotation steps.

tom: ops note: re-enable pipeline after partner confirms rotation and we've scrubbed history.

ryan: creating incident INC-2026-051 and adding assigned owners + timeline. please add any artifacts to the incident doc. link: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-051

sofia: postmortem items: improve pre-commit scanning on mirrors, add enforcement to block .env pushes, and air-gapped creds for partner mirrors. i'll add to infra backlog.

anika: also add a temporary alert for any vault tokens leaked to repos via regex to secops.

ryan: closing action items for containment: GCP key disabled, vault token revoked, evidence captured, rotation jobs scheduled. will follow up with postmortem next week. thanks everyone.
